text.answer: Whisper fires four attacks before reloading; Jhin cannot basic attack during the reload. The final round always critically strikes and adds physical damage based on the target's missing health. Critical strikes grant him a burst of movement speed, and critical strike chance and bonus attack speed increase his passive's bonus AD.
text.counterplay: Respect the final round when wounded; look for pressure during his reload and expect him to reposition after a critical strike.

text.counterplay: Keep distance from dying minions and nearby bounce targets.

text.answer: Deadly Flourish is a long-range physical shot that passes through minions and monsters but stops at the first champion hit. Champions damaged by Jhin or allied champions, or who trigger a Lotus Trap, are briefly marked; hitting a marked champion roots them and grants Jhin movement speed.

text.answer: Curtain Call channels up to four extreme-range shots into a cone fixed in front of Jhin; its opening sound and firing area are audible and visible to both teams. Shots pass through minions and monsters but stop at the first champion, slowing and revealing them. They deal physical damage that increases with missing health, and the final shot critically strikes for bonus damage.
text.counterplay: Move across the firing lines or out of the cone; be especially cautious while wounded and do not rely on minion cover.
